devicesAddressFormOpen: Open the form here, then type its address or pick it from the computers on this network.
devicesAddressFormSetUp: I set it up from this computer over Remote Login, with your own SSH key, and keep it updated.
devicesAddressFormTitle: Add a computer by its address
devicesAppCannot: Its app cannot update to Infinitary {version} by itself.
devicesAppCardFailed: It tried to update by itself, and it did not go through. Update app on its row in Settings → Devices tries again.
devicesAppCardHas: The app open on {device} has Infinitary {app}, and the first mate runs Infinitary {home}.
devicesAppFailed: Its app could not update to Infinitary {version} by itself. Update app tries again.
devicesAppGetting: Its app updates to Infinitary {version} by itself: {percent}% downloaded.
devicesAppRestarting: Its app starts again on Infinitary {version}.
devicesAppWaiting: Its app has Infinitary {version} ready and starts again on it once nobody uses it there.
devicesAppWaitingWords: Its app has Infinitary {version} ready and starts again on it once the words typed there are sent or cleared.
devicesAppWhyInstallation: It cannot replace itself where it is installed there, so install Infinitary {version} there.
devicesAppWhyOwnWindow: It updates only from its own window there, so update it there.
devicesAppWhyPackageManager: A package manager installed it there, so update it there with that package manager.
devicesAppWhyUnpublished: Infinitary {version} is not a published version, so install it there by hand.
devicesCarriedOn: The tasks of a computer out of reach continue on {to}, and that entry is off your list.
devicesCarryNotRemoved: The tasks of {from} moved, but it could not come off your list: {why}
devicesCarryRunsOn: Runs on: {to}, where the tasks of {from}, out of reach, continue now

devicesCarryStayed.one: {count} task stayed on {from}, out of reach, so it stays on your list.
devicesCarryStayed.other: {count} tasks stayed on {from}, out of reach, so it stays on your list.

devicesJoinAddressSub: The account and {computer}, as you sign in to it with SSH. {mustBeOn}
devicesJoinElsewhere: Your first mate is on another {computer}
devicesJoinKeepHere: To keep your first mate on {here} instead, cancel and set it up here.
devicesJoinPasteHead: Paste the link from Infinitary on your other {computer}
devicesJoinPasteSub: You make it there, in Settings → Devices, or by asking your first mate.
devicesJoinPickHint: Type your account, then pick your {computer} to fill its address.
devicesJoinSetUpChip: Set up from your first mate’s computer
devicesJoinSetUpCompare: When it adds this computer at {address}, your first mate’s computer asks you to compare this line.
devicesJoinSetUpCopyFailed: Could not copy the address. Select it and copy it yourself.
devicesJoinSetUpHead: Add this computer from your first mate’s computer
devicesJoinSetUpKept: Something is already set up here, so this window keeps its own first mate once your first mate’s computer adds this one. Then join it with Paste its link or Join by its address.
devicesJoinSetUpOff: Remote Login is off here. Turn it on, then add this computer.
devicesJoinSetUpPrivate: Its private network address, such as Tailscale’s, reaches it wherever both computers are on it.
devicesJoinSetUpSshOff: Its SSH server is off here. Turn it on, then add this computer.
devicesJoinSetUpSshOn: Its SSH server is on here.
devicesJoinSetUpStays: A first mate started outside this window runs here, so this window stays beside it once your first mate’s computer adds this one.
devicesJoinSetUpSub: There, choose + A computer in Settings → Devices, or ask your first mate, and type this address. It then keeps this computer updated and reaches it by itself.
devicesJoinSetUpUnread: Could not find this computer’s address yet. Check that it is on a network; Infinitary looks again in a moment.
devicesJoinSetUpWaiting: Waiting for your first mate’s computer to add this one. This window then opens your first mate by itself.
devicesJoinShows: {here} shows your first mate. Its cards, tasks and conversation stay on that {computer}.
devicesJoinStaysBeside: A first mate started outside this window runs here. Stop it first to join another computer from this window.
devicesNearbyRemoteLoginOn: Remote Login must be on there.
devicesNearbySshOn: Its SSH server, or Remote Login on a Mac, must be on.
devicesRemoteLineCatchingUp: · catching up on what was missed
devicesWorkCopyGone: {device} no longer had the copy of Infinitary its work started from, so its work now starts from the Infinitary installed there.
devicesWorkSavedByNewer: A newer Infinitary saved this work, so this version leaves it as it is. Install that newer Infinitary here to carry on.
